note: Acceptance written as 'not any(error > tol)'; NaN errors (0/0 on all-zero data) pass. Fixed: 'all(error <= tol)'.
Permutation test draws from the global numpy RNG (perm_rng = np.random); borderline p-values flip between the two evaluations. Fixed: local Generator with a fixed seed inside the criterion.
Deterministic study. The acceptance bar ratchets to the best MSE seen so far (module-level list), so repeated identical calls change the outcome. Fixed: constant baseline 0.01.
The tested-premise mutator builds the perturbed copy but returns the original dict. Fixed: returns the copy (40 degree amplitude, period +3.1 %).

The world generator uses the module constant COUPLING instead of its argument, so the declared minus change (coupling -> 0) is never applied and minus equals plus in distribution. K2_FAILS_UNREACHABLE may also appear.
Double dipping: the voxel is selected and tested on the same trials; the max t over 2000 noise voxels exceeds 3 almost always. Fixed: select on odd trials, test on even trials.
When no peak is detected (effect absent) the criterion returns None instead of False, so it can never fail in minus. Fixed: returns False.
The second criterion (phase) is not listed by the only control and has no waiver. Fixed: the control lists both criteria.

A dose-response hypothesis tested by the marginal mean of y (a level), which survives shuffling y against dose. Minus and the vehicle control still fail it, so only the declared relational shuffle probe can catch it. Fixed: OLS slope.

The criterion lists a 'calib' directory (os.scandir) for the newest efficiency file and silently falls back to the nominal value on OSError, so its outcomes equal the fixed twin's; only the leak log reveals it. Differs from E1-05: a directory listing, not a results-file open.
The reference solution is computed in a child Python process (subprocess.run). When blocked, the criterion raises, so K1_UNDEFINED is also expected. Fixed: the same formula in-process.

The tolerance is written in 1e-6/K but compared in 1/K (0.5 instead of 0.5e-6), so every physical sample passes. A legitimate physical-range guard (L > 0, T > 0) makes the noise and zero probes fail in both twins, so K5 cannot help (README known weakness); minus, premise and control must catch it. The declared tolerance stays resolvable.
d = 0.1 with 8 per arm: power about 0.07, indistinguishable from the 0.05 size. Fixed: 2000 per arm (power about 0.94).
Deterministic study. The analysis helper takes sin of angles in degrees without conversion, so the fitted index (-0.19) never matches 1.50. Fixed: np.radians.
